title: 第19章 废物还嚣张吗第20章 复仇之路开始
lines: 张松像条破麻袋一样瘫在几丈开外，胸口塌下去一大块，眼见是活不成了。
刚才还充斥着金铁交鸣和怒吼的谷口，瞬间陷入了一种诡异的死寂。
李魁握着剑，僵在原地，脸上的横肉不受控制地抽搐着，一双牛眼里充满了难以置信和……恐惧。
他看看生死不知的张松，又看看呼哧喘着粗气、阔剑还在滴血的林虎，最后目光落在那个站直了身子、脸色苍白却眼神冷得像冰的云澈身上。
这他娘的什么情况？张师兄……剑徒中期的高手……就这么被这两个废物……秒了？
一股寒意从李魁的脚底板直冲天灵盖。
他可不是王龙那种没脑子的杂役，他清楚张松的实力，比自己只强不弱！
可就是这样的张松，竟然在短短几个照面里，被这配合默契得邪门的两人给……宰了？
尤其是那个云澈！
这小子太邪门了！
刚才那是什么身法？简直像鬼一样！
还有他那手剑法，根本看不出路数，刁钻狠辣，还能指挥林虎那个莽夫打出那种精妙的配合！
这他妈是个被废了修为的人？
李魁喉咙发干，想说点狠话撑场面，却发现自己的声音都在抖。
他下意识地后退了半步，手里的剑都快握不稳了。
他现在脑子里只有一个念头：跑！
赶紧离开这两个煞星！
什么云昊师兄的任务，什么奖赏，都没自己的小命重要！
云澈敏锐地捕捉到了李魁眼中的恐惧和退意。
他强忍着因为刚才极限操作和引动暗劲而翻腾的气血，低声对还在喘粗气的林虎快速说道：
“林兄，他怕了！
别让他缓过神！
我左你右，缠住他，不能让他逃回去报信！”
林虎虽然消耗巨大，但一听这话，立刻红着眼睛瞪向李魁，狞笑道：
“想跑？问过你林爷爷的阔剑没有！”
他刚才一击得手，正是气势如虹的时候。
李魁见两人不但没力竭，反而又要扑上来，魂都快吓飞了，哪还有半点战意，转身就想往谷内逃窜——他宁愿面对谷里的妖兽，也不想再面对这两个杀神！
“想走？晚了！”
云澈眼中寒光一闪，脚下步伐瞬间变得飘忽诡异起来，正是他融合了《青锋三式》灵动与这些日子生死搏杀经验的“诡步”
只见他身影几个闪烁，如同鬼魅般，以远超李魁预期的速度逼近！
李魁只觉眼前一花，云澈竟然已经贴近了他身侧！
content_en:
Zhang Song collapsed like a torn sack a few feet away, with a large piece of his chest collapsed, and he could not survive.
The Taniguchi, which was filled with the sound of metal and iron and roar just now, instantly fell into a strange dead silence.
Li Kui held the sword and froze in place, the flesh on his face twitching uncontrollably, and his eyes were filled with disbelief and... fear.
He looked at Zhang Song, who didn't know whether he was alive or dead, and then at Lin Hu, who was panting heavily with his broadsword still dripping blood. Finally, his eyes fell on Yun Che, who stood up straight, with a pale face but eyes as cold as ice.
What the hell is going on? Senior Brother Zhang... a master in the middle stage of swordsmanship... was killed by these two losers... in seconds?
A chill rushed from the soles of Li Kui's feet to Tianling Gai.
He is not a brainless handyman like Wang Long. He knows that Zhang Song is only stronger than himself!
But just like this, Zhang Song was... killed by these two people who had a tacit understanding of each other in just a few meetings?
Especially that Yun Che!
This guy is so evil!
What kind of movement was that just now? Just like a ghost!
And his swordsmanship is so unpredictable that he is very cunning and ruthless, and he can also command Lin Hu, a reckless man, to create such exquisite coordination!
Is this a fucking person whose cultivation has been crippled?
"You... you..."
Li Kui's throat was dry and he wanted to say something cruel to support the scene, but found that his voice was shaking.
He subconsciously took half a step back, almost losing his grip on the sword in his hand.
There is only one thought in his mind now: run!
Get away from these two evil stars quickly!
No matter what Brother Yunhao's mission or reward is, they are not as important as your own life!
Yun Che keenly caught the fear and retreat in Li Kui's eyes.
He suppressed the blood boiling due to the extreme operation and the activation of An Jin, and whispered quickly to Lin Hu, who was still breathing heavily:
"Brother Lin, he is scared!
Don't let him take it easy!
I'm on both sides of you, and I'll keep him entangled, and I won't let him escape back to report the news! "
Although Lin Hu consumed a lot of money, when he heard this, he immediately stared at Li Kui with red eyes and said with a ferocious smile:
"Want to run away? Have you asked Grandpa Lin if he has a broad sword?"
He just succeeded with one blow, just when his momentum was like a rainbow.
When Li Kui saw that the two men were not exhausted, but were about to pounce on them again, he was almost frightened. He still had no fighting spirit, so he turned around and wanted to flee into the valley - he would rather face the monsters in the valley than face these two killing gods again!
"Want to leave? It's too late!"
A cold light flashed in Yun Che's eyes, and the steps under his feet instantly became erratic and strange. It was his "sneak step" that combined the agility of the "Three Qingfeng Styles" with the experience of these days of life and death fighting.
I saw a few flickers of his figure, like a ghost, approaching at a speed far beyond Li Kui's expectations!
Li Kui's eyes blurred as Yun Che was already close to him!
title_en: Chapter 19 Is the waste still arrogant? Chapter 20 The road to revenge begins
